title: Delegate srcdoc's CSP list initialization to CSP.

labels.name: do not merge yet

body:
Following up on https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-csp/pull/210, this patch simplifies
the integration point between HTML and CSP, delegating the functionality entirely to
the latter.
